# Copilot Instructions for Lectures Repository

This repository contains lecture materials and educational content.

## Repository Context

This is a lectures repository designed to store and organize educational materials, course content, and teaching resources.

## Coding Standards and Best Practices

- Maintain clear and descriptive file names
- Use proper markdown formatting for documentation
- Keep content organized and easy to navigate
- Ensure all materials are properly documented
- Follow consistent naming conventions across the repository

## Documentation Guidelines

- Use clear and concise language
- Provide examples where applicable
- Include proper headings and structure
- Keep README files up to date
- Document any dependencies or requirements

## File Organization

- Group related materials together
- Use meaningful directory structures
- Include descriptive README files in subdirectories
- Maintain a logical hierarchy for course materials
